Message:
mm/memory: remove unnecessary pte_devmap case in copy_one_pte()

Since commit 25b2995a35b6 ("mm: remove MEMORY_DEVICE_PUBLIC support"),
the assignment to 'page' for pte_devmap case has been unnecessary.
Let's remove it.
